title: Enhanced egg animation, E-key interaction, visually distinct destructibles
description: 1. Enhanced egg hatch animation: large egg appears, wobbles 2-3 times, breaks with particle/light flash, pet appears with rarity color/name, camera zoom effect (~3 seconds total). 2. ProximityPrompt (E-key) at egg stations for hatch interaction. 3. Visually distinct destructibles: CoinPile as golden stacked cylinders with PointLight, DiamondPile as cyan rotated cube (diamond shape) with blue glow, Crate as large brown box with darker stripe/lid parts.
steps: Update EffectsController.lua to enhance egg hatch animation with bigger egg, more wobble, light flash, camera zoom
Update ZoneService.lua _spawnEggStations to add ProximityPrompt to egg station parts
Update Main.client.lua to handle ProximityPrompt triggered events for egg hatching
Update ZoneService.lua _spawnSingleDestructible to create visually distinct multi-part models for each type
acceptance_criteria: Egg hatch animation lasts ~3 seconds with visible wobble, crack, particle burst, and camera zoom
Egg stations have a ProximityPrompt that responds to E key
CoinPile destructibles are golden stacked flat cylinders with PointLight
DiamondPile destructibles are cyan/blue diamond-shaped (rotated cube) with blue PointLight
Crate destructibles are large brown boxes with lid detail, bigger than coins/diamonds
All three destructible types are visually clearly distinguishable
